title: cacalia pilgeriana
intro: Cacalia pilgeriana, commonly known as the Himalayan toothwort, is a plant species that belongs to the family Compositae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia pilgeriana are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
